g.aria-label: Fit the cables on a Raspberry Pi 5
in this order: the sockets may not be reachable once the card is in
Power off the Raspberry Pi 5: unplug its power, and its network cable if it is powered
over PoE.
If the housings are on the headers (after the bench check), take them off.
Press the P1 plug into socket P1 and the P2 plug into socket P2 on the underside of
the Acorn, each the way round it was when you put the flags on, until fully seated.

The plugs are sketched.
Put the Acorn in the M.2 slot and fit its screw.
Pi 5 with the PoE M.2 HAT+, from above.
M.2 slot: the yellow box at the top left
P1 housing: pins 19 to 26
P2 housing: pins 5 to 10
The red corner of each box is the housing's marked
The photo shows the HAT without its stacking header.
Fit the P1 housing on the 40-pin header pins 19 to 26, marked corner on pin 19, and
the P2 housing on the 40-pin header pins 5 to 10, marked corner on pin 5.
